fields.climate: arid; mild, pleasant winters; very hot, humid summers
fields.terrain: mostly low desert plain rising gently to low central escarpment
fields.resources: oil, associated and nonassociated natural gas, fish, pearls
fields.farm: lamb/mutton, dates, milk, tomatoes, chicken, eggs, sheep offal, sheepskins, eggplants, chillies/peppers
fields.exports: refined petroleum, aluminum, iron ore, aluminum wire, jewelry
fields.industries: petroleum processing and refining, aluminum smelting, iron pelletization, fertilizers, Islamic and offshore banking, insurance, ship repairing, tourism
fields.legal: mixed legal system of Islamic (sharia) law, English common law, Egyptian civil, criminal, and commercial codes; customary law
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service; 18-55 to voluntarily join the reserves
